"""Online joint-space visual controller for select_billiards_common_sense.
Uses only RCB camera observations, public camera calibration, and robot proprioception.
"""
from rcb_client import Robot
import numpy as np

DT = 0.1
FINGERS_OPEN = np.array([0.04, 0.04])


def qmul(a, b):
    w, x, y, z = a
    W, X, Y, Z = b
    return np.array([w*W-x*X-y*Y-z*Z, w*X+x*W+y*Z-z*Y,
                     w*Y-x*Z+y*W+z*X, w*Z+x*Y-y*X+z*W])


def qrotvec(q_from, q_to):
    """World-frame rotation vector taking q_from to q_to."""
    rel = qmul(q_to, q_from * np.array([1., -1., -1., -1.]))
    rel /= np.linalg.norm(rel)
    if rel[0] < 0:
        rel = -rel
    n = np.linalg.norm(rel[1:])
    if n < 1e-10:
        return 2.0 * rel[1:]
    return (2.0 * np.arctan2(n, rel[0]) / n) * rel[1:]


def estimate_pose_jacobian(robot, delta=0.08, row_dt=0.7):
    """Estimate d(hand xyz, rotation vector)/d(joints) by safe small probes."""
    obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=["forward"], video="none")
    now = np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
    q0 = now[:7].copy()
    limits = np.asarray(robot.spec()["action_types"]["joint_position"]["panda_joint_limits_rad"])
    actions = []
    directions = []
    for j in range(7):
        q1 = q0.copy()
        sign = 1.0 if q0[j] + delta <= limits[j, 1] else -1.0
        q1[j] += sign * delta
        actions.extend([np.r_[q1, FINGERS_OPEN], np.r_[q0, FINGERS_OPEN]])
        directions.append(sign)
    res = robot.submit("joint_position", np.asarray(actions), dt=row_dt,
                       interpolate="linear", cameras=None, video="none",
                       note="small joint probes for measured hand Jacobian")
    P = np.asarray(res.proprio, dtype=float)
    np.save("/app/output/jacobian_probe_proprio.npy", P)
    # At 10 Hz proprio sampling, each 0.7 s row contributes seven samples.
    ds, dxs = [], []
    for j in range(7):
        a, b = P[14*j], P[14*j + 7]
        ds.append(b[:7] - a[:7])
        dxs.append(np.r_[b[16:19] - a[16:19], qrotvec(a[19:23], b[19:23])])
    ds, dxs = np.asarray(ds), np.asarray(dxs)
    # dx = J @ dq; solve jointly to account for small servo drift on other joints.
    J = np.linalg.lstsq(ds, dxs, rcond=None)[0].T
    return J


def solve_joint_step(J, current_pose, target_xyz, target_quat, limits, damping=0.001):
    """Damped least-squares update for a short measured Cartesian waypoint."""
    current_xyz, current_quat = current_pose[:3], current_pose[3:]
    err = np.r_[target_xyz - current_xyz, qrotvec(current_quat, target_quat)]
    # Give a radian of wrist rotation about 20 cm of translation in the solve.
    W = np.diag([1., 1., 1., 0.2, 0.2, 0.2])
    A, b = W @ J, W @ err
    dq = A.T @ np.linalg.solve(A @ A.T + np.eye(6)*damping, b)
    peak = np.max(np.abs(dq))
    if peak > 0.58:
        dq *= 0.58 / peak
    return dq


def move_waypoint(robot, xyz, duration=3.0):
    obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=["forward"], video="none")
    now = np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
    q = now[:7].copy()
    pose = np.r_[now[16:19], now[19:23]]
    limits = np.asarray(robot.spec()["action_types"]["joint_position"]["panda_joint_limits_rad"])
    J = estimate_pose_jacobian(robot)
    dq = solve_joint_step(J, pose, np.asarray(xyz, dtype=float), pose[3:], limits)
    target = np.clip(q + dq, limits[:, 0] + 0.01, limits[:, 1] - 0.01)
    row = np.r_[target, FINGERS_OPEN]
    res = robot.submit("joint_position", row[None, :], dt=duration,
                       interpolate="linear", cameras=["forward"], video="none",
                       note=f"measured Jacobian waypoint {np.asarray(xyz).tolist()}")
    print("waypoint", xyz, "joint_step", np.round(target-q, 3).tolist(),
          "actual_tcp", res.meta.get("proprio", {}).get("now", [])[16:19],
          "meta", {k: res.meta.get(k) for k in ("control_steps", "done", "reason")})
    return res


def main():
    robot = Robot()
    print("status", robot.status())
    obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=["forward", "left", "right"], video="none")
    obs.save("/app/output/controller_observation")
    # First safe waypoint: move out from the high home pose while staying well above the table.
    move_waypoint(robot, (0.0, -0.05, 0.90), duration=3.0)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
